mistakes.text: If she will stay still, the dragonfly will stay on the reed.
mistakes.normalized: if she will stay still the dragonfly will stay on the reed
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ patrí v First Conditional Present Simple: „if she/he stays“, nie „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ patří ve First Conditional Present Simple: „if she/he stays“, ne „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In First Conditional use Present Simple after “if”: “if she/he stays”, not “will stay”.

mistakes.text: If he will stay still, the dragonfly will stay on the reed.
mistakes.normalized: if he will stay still the dragonfly will stay on the reed
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ patrí v First Conditional Present Simple: „if she/he stays“, nie „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ patří ve First Conditional Present Simple: „if she/he stays“, ne „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In First Conditional use Present Simple after “if”: “if she/he stays”, not “will stay”.

mistakes.text: If she stays still, the dragonfly stays on the reed.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o konkrétny budúci následok, preto v First Conditional patrí „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o konkrétní budoucí následek, proto ve First Conditional patří „will stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is one specific future result, so First Conditional uses “will stay”.

mistakes.text: If she stays quiet, the dragonfly will stay on the reed.
mistakes.normalized: if she stays quiet the dragonfly will stay on the reed
mistakes.feedback_en: Not moving is “still”; “quiet” means making no sound.

mistakes.text: If he stays quiet, the dragonfly will stay on the reed.
mistakes.normalized: if he stays quiet the dragonfly will stay on the reed
mistakes.feedback_en: Not moving is “still”; “quiet” means making no sound.

mistakes.text: If she stays still, the dragonfly will stay in the reed.
mistakes.normalized: if she stays still the dragonfly will stay in the reed
mistakes.feedback_sk: Vážka sedí na jednom steble, preto „on the reed“, nie „in the reed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Vážka sedí na jednom stéble, proto „on the reed“, ne „in the reed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The dragonfly sits on top of one reed, so use “on the reed”, not “in”.

mistakes.text: If he stays still, the dragonfly will stay in the reed.
mistakes.normalized: if he stays still the dragonfly will stay in the reed
mistakes.feedback_sk: Vážka sedí na jednom steble, preto „on the reed“, nie „in the reed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Vážka sedí na jednom stéble, proto „on the reed“, ne „in the reed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The dragonfly sits on top of one reed, so use “on the reed”, not “in”.

source_issues: Slovak and Czech drop the subject pronoun, so “she” is not given; “he” is accepted too.
